title: Average calculator
description: Create a method named promedio that takes three double numbers and returns their average.
hints: The method must be static to be able to call it from main
The return type must be double because the average can have decimals
The average is the sum divided by 3
solutionExplanation: The method takes three doubles and returns the sum divided by 3.0. Using 3.0 instead of 3 ensures floating point division.

title: Password validator with method
description: Create a method esValida(String password) that returns true if the password has at least 8 characters and contains both letters and numbers.
hints: Iterate over each character with a for loop
Use booleans to track whether you already found a letter and a digit
solutionExplanation: The method checks the length first (early return). Then it iterates over the characters checking whether there is at least one letter and one digit. It only returns true if both conditions are met.
expectedOutput:
abc12345 -> Valid
short -> Invalid
nosingles123 -> Valid

title: Unit converter with multiple methods
description: Create 4 static methods: kmAMillas, kgALibras, celsiusAFahrenheit, litrosAGalones. Each one takes a double and returns the converted result.
hints: Each method is static and has a single double parameter
The return type of each method is double
The formulas are in the exercise description
solutionExplanation: Each method encapsulates a conversion formula. They are static so they can be called from main without creating objects.
expectedOutput:
100 km   = 62.14 miles
75 kg    = 165.35 pounds
37C      = 98.60 F
20 liters= 5.28 gallons
